goal: Measure whether a frozen CPU source-separation plus note-transcription frontend can recognize the combined Rhythm+Lead guitar notes and Bass notes before any Rhythm/Lead role split, fret assignment, technique inference, or PDF rendering.

separator.reason: The four-stem htdemucs Other stem intentionally keeps Rhythm and Lead together so acoustic recognition is tested before musical role separation.

freezeOrder: separate htdemucs Other and Bass on CPU
transcribe Other and Bass with frozen Basic Pitch settings
persist generated stream JSON and hashes
only then open privately normalized professional references for scoring

primaryEvaluation.combinedGuitar: timing-aware same-MIDI one-to-one F1 against union of professional Rhythm+Lead within plus/minus 0.5 grid step
primaryEvaluation.bass: timing-aware same-MIDI one-to-one F1 against professional Bass within plus/minus 0.5 grid step
primaryEvaluation.grossDiagnostic: same-MIDI one-to-one F1 within plus/minus 2.0 grid steps

currentSessionConstraint.effect: Private note-by-note normalization cannot be faithfully reconstructed in this session. This preregistration is reference-independent and does not authorize scoring until normalized reference identities are available.

forbidden: Rhythm/Lead acoustic split before combined-guitar recognition
